The general consensus on the site, especially amongst the writers, is that Wondertainment is a family (or something more complicated, but that's delving too greedily and too deep into nerddom).

I don't think any of the SCPs that feature Wondertainment make it clear whether it/he is a company or a person, or both or neither :-o. The rest of your post is something I can agree with, though! I think he's on a different… set of standards than we are, so seeing him use children to get back at the Factory doesn't really change my image of him.

item.title: Author Post
item.content:encoded:
So, here we are. With a new picture, new effects, and new worldbuilding, we have a rewritten General-Beep. This rewrite actually means a lot to me; the old 958 was the first skip that stuck in my mind as something that didn't quite "fit" and being able to give it new life years later to continue my Wondertainment/Factory stuff is one of the more satisfying things I've done here. Made all the better by Tanhony being a super cool guy and letting me do it before the thing was even in deletion range.

Thanks to Anaxagoras and Decibelle for convincing me to rewrite the thing wholesale rather than try to incorporate some of its older writings. A huge, massive thanks to Roget for pushing me to change up the -B (Rip Corporal-Boop) - it really resulted in a much better article, and ended up being a bit closer to the old version because of it. Thanks to Randomini and kaktus for making me do an interview, and more thanks to Randomini for helping me tighten it up.

The original article, its image, and its discussion pages can be found in the Files of this page.
